title: In Major Leak Hunt, Pentagon Gives Polygraph Tests to Joint Staff Members
summary: About 50 people were tested, an unparalleled inquiry that comes in the wake of news reports about the war with Iran and the U.S. military’s diminished stocks of munitions.
